claims.gist: Hype Cycles show technology maturity and adoption and their relevance to business problems
Early adopters can reap rewards, though risky investments do not always pay off
Moderate executives should demand sound cost-benefit analysis for unproven approaches
Wait for maturation when commercial viability has too many open questions
Hype Cycles separate hype from the real drivers of commercial promise

thesis: Hype Cycles map technology maturity so leaders can choose early adoption, moderate investment, or waiting.
